additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397032-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002426] All outlets unavailable CRM:01811000532
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
We have analyzed the charger and identified an issue related to the fast shutdown wiring, which appears to be causing the converter error E:52. This error is user-generated and suggests a failure in the fast shutdown check. To address this, need to schedule a site intervention to carry out the following checks:
Examine the Fast Shutdown Wiring
: Please review the wiring connected to the fast shutdown system.
KF13 Voltage Output
: Check if the KF13 is sending a steady 12VDC output as required. If possible, please bring a spare KF13 for replacement.
QA(contactors) Switch Functionality
: After confirming that the KF13 is sending 12V, check whether the QAs are closing correctly.
Switching MG1-MG2 Connection
: Verify the connection on Switching MG1-MG2.
Check Terminal Connections
:
Inspect the connection on the +F03-XD6 terminal.
Verify the connections on XD9.2A/B and XD14.1A/B.
Ensure proper connections on +F03 XD5 for the 12VDC supply.
(Note: Refer KF14 as KF13)
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
